company.name: Onsitego
company.shortDescription: Onsitego is India’s leading device-care provider and offers Extended Warranty, Damage Protection, AMC Plans, and On-Demand Repair Services.
company.description:
Onsitego is India’s leading device-care provider and offers Extended Warranty, Damage Protection, AMC Plans, and On-Demand Repair Services. We cover all electronic devices and home appliances. Our plans are widely available across retail stores and online marketplaces.

We provide hassle-free services for the repair and maintenance of devices and appliances, thus improving the post-purchase ownership experience. Our customer obsession allows us to have the highest Net Promoter Score (NPS) globally in after-sales services.

Our award-winning customer service combined with our thoughtful plans ensure the best care you invest in for your devices & appliances.

productsAndServices.description: Extended Warranty Plans provide additional coverage for devices beyond the manufacturer’s warranty period, covering repairs and replacements due to mechanical or electrical failures.

productsAndServices.description: Damage Protection Plans cover accidental physical or liquid damage to devices, such as spills, drops, or other mishandling incidents.

productsAndServices.description: On-Demand Repair Services offer immediate repair assistance for devices without requiring a prior maintenance contract or warranty plan.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $9,523,402, or 33.39% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,941,512 to $104,077,175, a 4.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
